title: 第162章 熟悉这种情况
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“什么叫帮郑枋养，那也是我的孩子。”宋穗皱眉道。

郑梁当即变了脸色，“不行”

经过这么多天的相处，宋穗知道郑梁这人只能顺着说话，要是给他来硬的，他能比你更硬。

宋穗当即换了个说法，“我儿子可是王梅香如今唯一的孙子，就郑枋那个窝囊样，这辈子肯定再也娶不上媳妇。咱们把孩子带出来，那不就相当于断了王梅香的子孙香火了吗，王梅香到时候肯定着急。”

郑梁想了想，觉得宋穗说的竟然很有几分道理，看宋穗的眼神都不一样了。

“你说的对。”

宋穗觉得郑梁看自己的眼神怪怪的。

“你怎么这么看我？”

郑梁摇头，“我是没想到你这个女人，表面看着柔柔弱弱的，竟然还是个狠家伙。”

宋穗不知道郑梁这句话是在夸自己，还是在损自己。

她坐到郑梁身边，露出手腕上的银镯子，这是郑梁昨天晚上在赌场赌赢了之后，专门给她买的。

“我原本想嫁的那个人就是你，可你那时候偏偏不在家，所以我没法子，这才选了郑枋。”

宋穗隐约记得，今年的米很贵，于是提议，“今年开春的时候，有个算卦的到咱们村算卦，我无意中听见那人说今年光景不如往年，好像会下大雨，到时候粮价贵。不如，咱们趁着这时候囤些粮。”

郑梁一下就笑了，“你还信那些人的话？那些算卦的要是真算的准，怎么可能还会那么穷。”

宋穗笑了笑，“反正你手里也有些钱，不如就做点小买卖试试，万一赚钱了呢。”

郑梁想了想，觉得挺对。

“行，明天就去干。”

宋穗听了之后面色大喜。

果然郑枋是个烂泥扶不上墙的货色，只要自己离开郑枋换一个人，自己绝对就能过上好日子。

“孩子的时？”宋穗又问。

“不着急。”郑梁说，“现在咱们回村子，可不是让人来逮吗？”

宋穗点点头，只能压下心中的那点想法。

这几天往保平府做布料生意的罗老板又从新棉织坊订购了一批布。

宋禾格外的忙，她需要盯着生产质量，还得把关染线方面，顺便在盯着纺纱。

这些日子宋禾计划再次扩大织坊布料种类，决定在织坊里增加麻线织坊。

Page (1/3)

"What do you mean by helping Zheng Fang raise him? That's my child too." Song Sui frowned.

Zheng Liang's expression immediately changed, "No"

After getting along with each other for so many days, Song Sui knew that Zheng Liang could only listen to what he said. If you give him a hard time, he can be harder than you.

Song Sui immediately changed her explanation, "My son is Wang Meixiang's only grandson now. He is as useless as Zheng Fang. He will never be able to marry a wife again in this life. If we take the child out, wouldn't it be equivalent to cutting off the relationship between Wang Meixiang's descendants? Wang Meixiang will definitely be anxious by then."

Zheng Liang thought for a while and felt that what Song Sui said was quite reasonable. The look in Song Sui's eyes was different.

"You're right."

Song Sui felt that Zheng Liang looked at her strangely.

"Why do you look at me like that?"

Zheng Liang shook his head, "I didn't expect that you, a woman who looks soft and weak on the surface, can actually be a cruel guy."

Song Sui didn't know whether Zheng Liang's words were praising him or hurting him.

She sat next to Zheng Liang, revealing the silver bracelet on her wrist, which Zheng Liang bought specially for her after winning the gambling at the casino last night.

"The person I originally wanted to marry was you, but you were not at home at that time, so I had no choice, so I chose Zheng Fang."

Song Sui vaguely remembered that rice was very expensive this year, so she suggested, "At the beginning of spring this year, a fortune teller came to our village to tell fortunes. I overheard that person saying that the situation this year is not as good as in previous years. It seems that there will be heavy rain and the price of food will be expensive. Why don't we take advantage of this time to stock up on food."

Zheng Liang laughed immediately, "Do you still believe what those people say? If those fortune tellers were really accurate, how could they still be so poor?"

Song Sui smiled and said, "You have some money anyway, why not try doing some small business, just in case you make money."

Zheng Liang thought about it and felt it was right.

"Okay, let's do it tomorrow."

Song Sui looked overjoyed after hearing this.

As expected, Zheng Fang is a piece of shit who can't hold up a wall. As long as he leaves Zheng Fang and finds someone else, he will definitely be able to live a good life.

"Children's time?" Song Sui asked again.

"There's no rush." Zheng Liang said, "Now when we go back to the village, shouldn't we be arrested by someone?"

Song Sui nodded and could only suppress the thoughts in his heart.

Boss Luo, who went to Baoping Prefecture to do fabric business these days, ordered a batch of cloth from the new cotton weaving mill.

Song He is extremely busy. She needs to keep an eye on production quality, dyeing threads, and spinning.

These days, Song He plans to expand the variety of fabrics in the weaving workshop again, and decides to add a hemp thread weaving workshop to the weaving workshop.
